Different "variable names" are assigned to each variable definition and year combination, so having the full variable list is sufficient for recovering the data.

Rename it to `PSID/J362369.txt` and run `J362369.do`, `J362369_formats.do` and `J362369_tolong.do` in this order.

See `psid_varselect.xlsx` for variable definitions and mappings of variable names to specific years and definitions.
